item.title: 3 Ways to Source Herbs
item.description: Explore the many ways to source herbs. No matter where you live, taking charge of your health and making home remedies is possible.

item.title: How to Make a Topical Oil Infusion
item.description: Discover the power of topical oil infusion and learn how to create your own infused oils for various skin and oral health concerns.

item.title: Herbal Hot Chocolate Mix
item.description: Indulge in a creamy cup of hot cocoa. Discover a healthier alternative to store-bought mixes and enjoy a cozy, homemade hot chocolate.

item.title: How to Make an Ingestible Oil Infusion
item.description: Learn how to make ingestible oil infusions for various purposes. Find out how to create these herbal extracts and unleash their potential.

item.title: How to Dry Fresh Herbs
item.description: Explore the various methods for drying fresh herbs and the importance of storing them properly. From air-drying, dehydrating, and even oven-drying, preserving medicinal properties is a priority. Using low temperatures to thoroughly dry herbs helps maintain flavor and nutrients while ensuring the herbs’ longevity and potency.

item.title: How to Make an Herbal Salve
item.description: Discover how to transform herbs into ointments that promote skin health and healing. Learn about the best herbs for salve-making and understand the importance of using sterile preparation processes to create an herbal-infused oil. Then, add wax to create a topical product with a one-year shelf life.

item.title: How to Make an Herbal Syrup
item.description: Learn how to create herbal syrups by combining herbal infusions, decoctions, or tinctures with a sweetener. These simple and delicious natural remedies are excellent for transforming bitter-tasting herbs into a delightful medicine, making them an excellent choice for those sensitive to strong flavors, especially children.

item.title: How to Make Herbal Capsules
item.description: Discover the power of herbal capsules, commonly used as a natural remedy; they can easily be opened and sprinkled into food or beverages. Learn how to take dried, powdered herbs and create a convenient capsule for daily supplementation. Unravel the art of home encapsulation while understanding crucial sourcing, dosage, and storage factors.

item.title: Turkey Tail: Health Benefits, Safety Information, & How to Use
item.description: Explore the research-backed benefits of Turkey Tail (Trametes versicolor). Discover tips for foraging, growing, and use in your herbal kitchen.

item.title: Garlic: Health Benefits, Safety Information, & How to Use
item.description: Discover the research-backed benefits and history of garlic (Allium sativum). Explore tips for growing it from bulbs for use in your herbal kitchen.
